units: <cite ref="Chullin 45b:20">Ḥull. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>גדי שמן</he> Rashi (ed. <he>גדי שמינה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) a fat kid.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 9:1:4">Y. B. Kam. IX, beg. 6ᵈ</cite> <he>גזל ש׳ והכחישה וכ׳</he> if he took by force a fat animal, and it became lean &c., v. <cite ref="U00448"><he>שׁוּמָן</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="U01508"><he>שְׁמֵנִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01498"><he>שְׁמֵי׳</he></cite>; <he>שְׁמֵנוֹת</he>, <cite ref="U01498"><he>שְׁמֵי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 66:3">Gen. R. s. 66</cite> <he>דגים ש׳ יתיר מדאי</he> exceedingly fat fish.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:12">Num. R. s. 16<sup>12</sup></cite> <he>אם … אם ש׳</he> whether its fruits are light or rich; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:12">ib.</cite> <he>אם של צונמא … ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="R00210"><he>צוֹנָם</he></cite>; Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 6; a. fr.
